test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Judicious
solution:
The correct answer is 'Thoughtful.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word '**Judicious**' means **Sensible and carefully considered; showing good judgment**. 

 
 
• Example: *We should listen to the **judicious** opinion of that old man*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
 
 
• '**Graceful**' means **Having or showing grace or elegance**.
 
 
• Example: *Her movements were **graceful** and elegant*.
 
 
 
• '**Thoughtful**' means **Absorbed in or involving thought; thinking deeply**.
 
 
• Example: *He has a **thoughtful** approach to his work*.
 
 
 
• '**Beautiful**' means **Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically**.
 
 
• Example: *Mountains look **beautiful** from a distance*.
 
 
 
• '**Plentiful**' means **Existing in or yielding great quantities; abundant**.
 
 
• Example: *Hot climate and **plentiful** rainfall favor the growth of plants*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The synonyms of the word 'Judicious' are "Thoughtful**, Sensible, Prudent**".
 
• The antonyms of the word 'Judicious' are "**Imprudent, Indiscreet, Injudicious**".
